custom_fields.label: Full Access (All Data)
custom_fields.description: When checked, user can access all transactions across all fiscal years. When unchecked, access is restricted based on specific fiscal year assignments below.

custom_fields.label: Fiscal Year Access
custom_fields.description: Specify which doctypes and fiscal years this user can access. If 'Full Access (All Fiscal Years)' is checked for a row, user can see all fiscal years for that doctype.
